# InvestSphere — Source Catalog & Folder Paths

**14 structured datasets** (7 reference CSV + 3 transaction JSON + 4 valuation CSV)
**+ 4 PDF documents.** Local sample is generated by `data/generate_data.py` and
`data/generate_documents.py`.

| # | Dataset | Local folder | Format | Bronze table | Databricks landing path |
|---|---------|--------------|--------|--------------|--------------------------|
| 1 | portfolio_master | `data/reference_data/` | CSV | `raw_portfolio_master` | `/Volumes/investsphere/bronze/raw/portfolio_master/` |
| 2 | investment_asset_master | `data/reference_data/` | CSV | `raw_investment_asset_master` | `.../raw/investment_asset_master/` |
| 3 | issuer_master | `data/reference_data/` | CSV | `raw_issuer_master` | `.../raw/issuer_master/` |
| 4 | counterparty_master | `data/reference_data/` | CSV | `raw_counterparty_master` | `.../raw/counterparty_master/` |
| 5 | investment_limits | `data/reference_data/` | CSV | `raw_investment_limits` | `.../raw/investment_limits/` |
| 6 | benchmark_or_target_allocation | `data/reference_data/` | CSV | `raw_benchmark_or_target_allocation` | `.../raw/benchmark_or_target_allocation/` |

## Rules
- **One landing subfolder per dataset** (Auto Loader reads a folder per source).
- **Immutable filenames** in the landing zone (e.g. `investment_transactions_2026_06_04_0900.json`).
  File-arrival triggers fire on *new* files; overwriting a name does not trigger.
- Asset key is **`investment_asset_id`**; `isin` is a nullable attribute (listed only).
- Transaction id is **`transaction_id`**; transaction date is **`transaction_date`**.
- Only **approved, non-restricted** documents are indexed by AI Search (the private
  investment committee memo is excluded).
